overall: MARGINAL now, good by mid-morning: very light wind, dry
limiterDetail: The main limiter is current , only in the south and west. Wind is very light: ECMWF 0.9–6.0 kt now (gusts 4–9), staying under 7 kt all day and building to only 4–7 kt by Monday dawn. Rain is not a factor: dry over the next 24h, with 0.1 mm traces at Linapacan, Alava and Binudac. The current is peaking now (6–8 AM) , eases 10 AM–2 PM , picks up again about 4–7 PM , and goes slack about 10 PM–3 AM.

pagasa.status: no gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA.
pagasa.detail: PAGASA: no gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA. The feed still references the Tropical Cyclone Alert for Typhoon Rosal (Champi) , not covering Palawan. The latest items (to Sun 25 Oct 5:22 AM PHT) are general flood advisories for Cagayan Valley, the Visayas regions and BARMM, none covering Palawan.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: No material change to near-term supply: arrivals recover today and stay normal through Tuesday. The early-morning current pickup has the grounds at 3 GOOD / 7 MARGINAL / 5 POOR / 1 VERY POOR right now (was 6 / 7 / 3 / 0 yesterday afternoon), the same morning pattern as Saturday. Coron, Ciron and Panlaitan are GOOD; Decabaitot is VERY POOR at 1.7 kt and eases by midday.

Next week shifted: Mon 26 is now mostly dry (was 5.8 mm moderate rain), Tue 27 light 3.9 mm, Wed 28 light 3.5 mm. Thu 29 is still the hardest day (11 kt, gusts 20, 4.5 mm). Fri 30 eased to 4.1 kt (gusts 18, 2.0 mm). New: Sat 31 has moderate rain, 13.4 mm , the wettest day of the week. Today is the calmest day (3.3 kt, gusts 7, dry). PAGASA still has nothing for Palawan.

details: 10 AM–2 PM today: Coron, Galoc, Maglalambay and Panlaitan on 0.1–0.3 kt current, Ciron 0.2–0.3, Linapacan 0.2–0.4, wind under 5 kt, dry.
10 PM–3 AM tonight: the widest slack, with Culion and Alava 0.1–0.3, Decabobo 0.0–0.2, Galoc, Maglalambay, Panlaitan and Linapacan 0.1–0.2, wind 2–6 kt.
Keep boats off Decabaitot, Tara, Turda and Alava through this morning's pickup (to about 9 AM) and the 5–7 PM peak.
